info.title: Search Creator Affiliate Orders
info.description:
Search Creator Affiliate Orders
This API allows the partner to retrieve a list of affiliate orders generated by a creator, returning the order ID and the product ID. Using this, the partner can track their affiliate-conversions on behalf of a creator, using the order ID.

post.description:
Search Creator Affiliate Orders
This API allows the partner to retrieve a list of affiliate orders generated by a creator, returning the order ID and the product ID. Using this, the partner can track their affiliate-conversions on behalf of a creator, using the order ID.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The creator access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 1. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a362dccb8030ea6f98c) to get creator access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set. Retrieve this value from the result of the `next_page_token` from a previous response. It is not needed for the first page.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
The number of results to be returned per page. Default: 20
Valid Range: [1-100]

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

create_time_ge.description:
Filter orders to show only those that are created on or after the specified date and time. Unix timestamp.
Note:
`create_time_ge` and `create_time_lt` together constitute the creation time filter condition.
- If `create_time_ge` is filled but `create_time_lt` is empty, `create_time_lt` will default to the current time.
- If `create_time_lt` is filled but `create_time_ge` is empty, `create_time_ge` will default to the earliest shop time.

create_time_lt.description:
Filter orders to show only those that are created before the specified date and time. Unix timestamp.
Refer to notes in `create_time_ge` for more usage information.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

create_time.description: Time and date of order created, UTC+0 timing

delivery_time.description: Time and date order delivered, UTC+0 timing

status.description:
The current status of the order. Possible options are:
- UNSPECIFIED: The status of the order is undefined. It might be updated later.
- AWAITING PAYMENT：The order hasn't been paid yet, only estimated commission is available
- To-SETTLE：The order is waiting for settlement, only estimated commission is available
- SETTLED: The commission of the order is already settled.
- REFUNDED: The order has been returned/refunded/canceled by the buyer, and no commission will be settled.
- FROZEN: Possible fraud has been detected regarding the order. The commission will be unfrozen after the fraud is resolved.

campaign_id.description: The campaign identifier associated with the order.

open_collaboration_id.description: The open collaboration identifier associated with the order.

target_collaboration_id.description: The target collaboration identifier associated with the order.

product_name.description: The product name in the TikTok Shop.

amount.description: The value of the price associated with the product.

currency.description: The currency code of the price associated with the product.

price.description: An object representing the localized price of the product.

shop_name.description: The name of the TIkTok Shop in which the product is offered for sale.

content_type.description:
The content format of the creator content through which the order was created.
Possible values:
- SHOP
- VIDEO
- LIVE
- PRE_LIVE
- PROMOTION_PAGE
- LINKSHARE

content_id.description: The content identifier for the creator content through which the order was created.

quantity.description: The total number of SKUs per order, calculated by aggregating the number of ordered product SKUs associated with the order.

commission_rate.description: The total commission rate of this SKU, equal to the sum of standard commission rate + shop ads commission rate + bonus rate + reward rate. Expressed in units of hundredths of a percent formatted as a string. The percent sign % is not included in the string. For example, 3000 represents a 30% commission.

commission_tier_setting.description: Between Seller & Creator percentagecommission. When tiering commission model applied, will return each tier's commission rate seller set.

commission_model.description:
Determine order commission be calculated based on fixed commission model or tiering
model

commission_bonus_rate.description: The commission bonus rate associated with the collaboration. Expressed in units of hundredths of a percent formatted as a string. The percent sign % is not included in the string. For example, 3000 represents a 30% commission.

estimated_commission_base.description: An object representing the estimated base commission at the time of order creation.

standard_commission_rate.description: The standard affiliate commission rate associated with the collaboration. Expressed in units of hundredths of a percent formatted as a string. The percent sign % is not included in the string. For example, 3000 represents a 30% commission.

shop_ads_commission_rate.description: The commission rate received by a creator for a sale associated with a specific piece of content. Expressed in units of hundredths of a percent formatted as a string. The percent sign % is not included in the string. For example, 3000 represents a 30% commission.

estimated_bonus_commission.description: An object representing the estimated bonus commission, calculated by multiplying the estimated commission base by the commission bonus rate.

estimated_standard_commission.description: An object representing the estimated shop ads commission, calculated by multiplying the estimated commission base by the standard_commission_rate

amount.description: The estimated shop ads commission rate.

estimated_shop_ads_commission.description: An object representing the estimated shop ads commission, calculated by multiplying the estimated commission base by the shop_ads_commission_rate

estimated_commission.description: The estimated creator commission, calculated by multiplying the product sales price by the total number of products at the time of order creation.

actual_commission.description: Represents the final earnings of this sku, calculated by multiplying the actual commission base by the total commission rate, and then deducting the taxes or revenue sharing with the agency amount.

actual_bonus_commission.description: An object representing the actual bonus commission, calculated by multiplying the actual commission base by the commission bonus rate.

amount.description: The value of the actual commission base.

actual_commission_base.description: An object representing the actual commission base, calculated by multiplying the product sale price by the number of products sold, subtracting returned and refunded orders.

actual_standard_commission.description: An object representing the actual standard affiliate commission, calculated by multiplying the commission base by the standard_commission_rate.

amount.description: The actual shop ads commission amount.

actual_shop_ads_commission.description: An object representing the actual shop ads commission, calculated by multiplying the commission base by the shop_ads_commission_rate.

returned_quantity.description: The total number of returned SKUs associated with the order.

refunded_quantity.description: The total number of refunded SKUs associated with the order.

tag.description: A field for storing user-defined metadata for tracking purposes.

creator_commission_reward_rate.description: The commission reward rate affiliate partners allocate to creators

amount.description: The estimated fee creators receive from affiliate partners through commission rewards
The actual fee creators receive from affiliate partners through commission rewards

isr.description: Only for Mexico creator, platform collected related revenue taxes on behalf of government based on regulation.

iva.description: Only for Mexico creator, platform collected related revenue taxes on behalf of government based on regulation.

pit.description: Only for VN/TH/PH/ID creators, sellers collect related withholding taxes based on regulation.

amount.description: The actual shared with partner amount.

shared_with_partner.description: The parts of after-taxes creator revenue which need to be shared with CAP based on the fee agreement

id.description: When `trace.type==GENERAL`, the value is {eid} you provided in `sharing_link`; when `trace.type==SPECIFIC`, the value is the same as `publisher_id`.

type.description: For the orders coming from the sharing links for specific publishers, the value is `SPECIFIC`; for the orders coming from the general sharing links, the value is `GENERAL`.

last_update_time.description: The time when the record was last updated.

skus.description: A list of SKUs associated with the order.

next_page_token.description: An opaque token used to retrieve the next page of a paginated result set.

total_count.description: Total count of orders in the response.
